summary.text: Justin Humphrey, a Republican from Lane, was elected in 2017 to represent District 19 in the Oklahoma House of Representatives, which includes Choctaw and Pushmataha counties and parts of Atoka and Bryan counties. He is vice chair of the House Public Safety and Tourism committees.

paragraphs.text: Humphrey is an Atoka High School graduate and earned a bachelor's degree in criminal justice with a minor in business administration from East Central University.
He worked for the Oklahoma Department of Corrections for 20 years, including as a DARE officer and a probation officer.
From 2010 to 2016 he was administrator of the Atoka/Coal County drug court, and in 2010 he owned a private company that contracted drug court supervision and probation.
In the House he has previously chaired the Criminal Justice and Corrections and the Public Safety committees.
Humphrey also operates a cattle ranch in southeastern Oklahoma.
He and his wife, Carla, have three sons and attend Church of the Rock in Lane.
